records.deidentified_narrative: on friday, september 19, 2025, at approximately 1825 hours, netcom dispatch advised police and fire of a major accident that occurred at duffs famous wings, 2787 [roadway], southlake, tarrant county, texas 76092. dispatch advised that a vehicle drove through the side of the building with several injuries inside. upon arrival, officer's observed a white bmw bearing tx lp [identifier], that had driven through the north side of the patio, through the windows, and into the building. upon the vehicle striking the building, multiple pedestrians were injured inside. the driver, identified as ronald peddicord (w/m, dob [date]), stated that he was parking his vehicle, but wanted to park in the shade. he then readjusted to find a different parking spot. ronald stated that as he approached the curb and was waiting for his tires to hit the curb, he was waiving at the servers inside. he stated that at that moment he heard a loud revving sound from the vehicle and went over the curb and into the building. ronald mentioned that he may have hit the gas pedal instead of the brake pedal on accident as he was trying to park the vehicle. six total injuries were reported on scene. officer's secured the scene until fire and ems arrived to treat injuries and transport the injured. the vehicle was towed by b&b wrecker service. nothing further to report.
